author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: HIRING Looking for Freelance Artists
content:
HIRING
LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS

Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang.

Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam:
-Character Design & Illustration
-Character Sprites
-Background & Environment Art
-Webtoon / Comic Artwork
-Game & Digital Art Assets
-Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya

Kualifikasi:
-Memiliki portofolio yang kuat dan dasar menggambar yang baik
-Mampu mengikuti art direction yang telah ditentukan atau beradaptasi dengan berbagai gaya visual
-Memahami anatomi, komposisi, dan penggunaan warna dengan baik
-Mampu menyelesaikan pekerjaan sesuai dengan deadline proyek
Terbiasa menerima feedback dan melakukan revisi
-Memiliki komunikasi profesional dan etos kerja yang dapat diandalkan

Cara Melamar:
Bagi Anda yang tertarik untuk bergabung sebagai freelance artist, silakan kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke:
avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com

Gunakan subject email:
Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]

Dalam email, Anda juga dapat mencantumkan:
Jenis artwork yang Anda kuasai atau minati
Art style yang biasa Anda gunakan
Ketersediaan untuk mengerjakan proyek
Rate freelance

Artist yang terpilih akan dihubungi untuk kesempatan berkolaborasi pada proyek-proyek freelance mendatang bersama Avetetsuya Studios.

author: Anonymous participant
title: Looking for a Long-Term Artist for Weekly Character Art
content:
**(ENG/TAG OK!) LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST!**

Hello! I'm an ASMR RP creator on YouTube based overseas, and I'm looking for a reliable long-term artist to work with on a weekly basis for thumbnails and videos! I'm currently working with a limited budget, so I'm hoping to find an artist whose rates are a good fit for ongoing weekly commissions!

I'm looking for:
* Weekly character art - 1x Simple rendered anime-style bust up or half body art of my OC per week (hopefully to be expanded to full body eventually once my income & budget increases!)
* Expression variations - Multiple facial expressions on the same art base - PSD file organized into separate layers for eyes/mouth/eyebrows/etc. for ability to mix & match
* Occasional additional elements - Small add-ons may be requested (such as a tear overlay, hand caressing the face, etc.). Additional compensation can be discussed

Ideally, I'd love to have each illustration to be completed within a week of providing the script + directions. However I am very happy to discuss a timeline that works best with both of us, as long as we can maintain a consistent weekly schedule ^^

Please only respond if you:
* Are over the age of 18
* Have read through this post all the way (please add ANY flower emoji to your reply)
* Can reliably commit to weekly commissions and deliver them on time!

If you're interested, please feel free to reply with your commission rates and relevant examples of your work! I will be reaching out via DM for further discussions :)

(You might have to check spam coz this is like a brand new account I made for anonymity LOL)

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon (Garchomp and Lucario)
content:
LF people who can draw Pokemon
You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how 😭 more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario.

I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style ,, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS!

This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too!
